ValidationRule.description: Section 14: the Acquisitions team must approve starting the LOI before the deal can be submitted for principal LOI approval. Gates the transition into LOI Under Approval; approval-process field updates bypass this rule.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'LOI Under Approval'), NOT(LOI_Prep_Approved__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Acquisitions team must approve LOI preparation (check LOI Prep Approved) before this deal can move to LOI Under Approval.
